scope: Second UX audit: public magazine spacing, typography, story-image representation and animal anatomy regression review.

coverage.method: Contact-sheet triage of active images, then full-size inspection of flagged scenes and previously corrected animal illustrations. Published story text read for every replaced illustration. Original documentary photographs and child drawings retained.
coverage.limits: Contact-sheet screening is not a full-resolution anatomy or semantic certification of all 714 writings. No claim of human editorial approval or specialist zoological/cultural certification.

resolved.finding: Homepage read action inherited the thumbnail/title grid, leaving the arrow midway across the card.
resolved.change: Scope grid to primary link; separate flex footer; consistent 16px card insets, readable author credits, 44px minimum read action.

resolved.finding: Fixed pixel reading text ignored browser font preferences.
resolved.change: Use rem for adjustable article/reader type; preserve saved numeric preferences; use actual root font size when calculating reader heading room.

resolved.finding: Small metadata and uneven heading/credit spacing.
resolved.change: Scalable headings, 16px-equivalent bylines, 14px-equivalent breadcrumbs/context; unitless line-height and wrapping.

resolved.finding: Older children’s illustrations were capped at 240px and had oversized issue metadata.
resolved.change: Full-width uncropped story art and smaller contextual metadata without rewriting source text.
Versioned AI-generated replacements with full text comparison, source files retained, card/reader/share alignment.

anatomy_regressions.review: Retained published corrected version; full-size visual inspection. Occluded limbs treated as occluded, not automatically missing.

validation.enlarged_text: 200% root font at 320,390,1280 on homepage, current issue, current article, older article and children’s contribution; 48px article text and working size controls.
validation.reader: 200% root font; 44px story text; controls inside screen at 320,390,1280; top controls wrap.
validation.image_delivery: All nine corrected main illustrations decode and use contain; original image hashes retained.
validation.build: Production build and required delivery, routing, sharing, discovery, ebook, writer and book UI checks passed.

references.use: Two-tier waterfall and green forest setting; the animal gathering itself is fictional and comes from the poem.

remaining_review_opportunities: Older imported images retain mixed visual styles; aesthetic difference alone was not treated as permission to replace source artwork.
Manual editor review of literary nuance and original historical imagery remains valuable; this is a targeted second audit, not an assertion that every old illustration is error-free.
Actual Safari/VoiceOver and reader-assisted accessibility validation remain unperformed.

guidance.typography: Support user zoom preferences: Allow users to resize text up to 200% without loss of content or functionality.
guidance.css: Write selectors in a way that expresses intent.
